_comment: Draft weapon mods for the Assault frame (the rifle). Stats are percent changes as fractions (0.25 = +25%). Stat names: range, recoil_side, recoil_up, magazine_size, reload_time, ads_move_speed, sway, zoom, ads_time, damage, fire_rate, crit_multiplier, swap_time, ready_time. Perks: focus, scavenger, brace, hunter, static, adrenal. Edit and restart the game to retune.

mods.name: Focus Barrel
mods.perk_text: Focus: after 5 hits in a row, +15% damage until you miss

mods.name: Scavenger Mag
mods.perk_text: Scavenger: each kill puts 20% of the magazine back

mods.name: Brace Stock
mods.perk_text: Brace: -40% recoil while crouched or sliding

mods.name: Static Rounds
mods.perk_text: Static: every 10th hit arcs lightning to 2 nearby enemies

mods.name: Adrenal Grip
mods.perk_text: Adrenal: a kill makes reloads 40% faster for 4 s
